follow-up time: Up to 24 hours after cesarean delivery
exposure: Moderate transfusion group (5 to 10 units of RBCs)
Mild transfusion group (fewer than 5 units of RBCs)
Massive transfusion group (10 or more units of RBCs)
cohort: 542 patients who underwent cesarean section, with 271 requiring blood transfusion for PPH and 271 not requiring transfusion
finding: The study identified pernicious placenta previa as an independent risk factor for all levels of blood transfusion after cesarean delivery.
